title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Role - Software Engineering Manager 
 Overview 
 This position is hybrid in Atlanta, Georgia and sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment.
 The Opportunity 
 The Manager, Software Engineering is a hands-on technical leader responsible for driving innovation, adopting new technologies, and leading change. The ideal candidate demonstrates technical depth and strong architectural understanding, enabling them to coach engineering teams, participate in feasibility discussions, support technical decisions, and is passionate about enabling modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development. In addition to removing blockers and maximizing team productivity, this leader champions scalable solutions and guides teams through change with empathy and clarity.
 Responsibilities 
 What Youll Be Doing Lead, mentor, and support a distributed team of Software Engineers, developing personalized career paths, and encouraging continuous upskilling including the use of AI-assisted tools for coding, documentation, testing, and code review. Provide strong technical guidance and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ethical use of AI across the team. Support engineers in maintaining focus and delivering quality outcomes by ensuring they understand clear priorities, allocating resources effectively, and resolving blockers early. Participate in architecture discussions, advocating for scalable, AI-ready systems, and modern development practices. Maintain and evolve a high-performing team culture by hiring top talent and reinforcing our values of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Track, analyze, and report on key engineering performance metrics (e.g., velocity, quality, cycle time), using insights to drive continuous improvement in team effectiveness and delivery outcomes. This job description in no way implies that the duties listed here are the only ones that team members can be required to perform Qualifications 
 What You Bring to the Team BS in Computer Science or a related field, or demonstrable equivalent experience. 8+ years of professional software development experience using technologies such as C#, WPF, Java, Python, and/or JavaScript. 4+ years of leadership experience with a focus on mentorship, career growth, and delivery. Proven ability to mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, from architecture to implementation. Strong grasp of software engineering best practices: Agile workflows, CI/CD, TDD, code reviews, and build/release automation. Experience working with Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with short release cycles and products in active production use. Deep knowledge of OOP principles, data structures, and algorithms. Demonstrated experience evaluating and integrating AI tools into development workflows, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. Committed to sound business ethics and handling of confidential information. Experience working in Product Operating Model is a plus.

title: S&C Global Network - AI -Song - CDP-Consultant
description:
About The Role  

 Entity :- Accenture Strategy Consulting

 Team :- Strategy Consulting Global Network

 Practice :- Marketing Analytics 

 Title :- Consultant/ Manager/Analyst Marketing Customer Data Platforms (GCP, CDP, Agentic AI)

 Job location :- Any out of 6 AI locations

 About SC - Global Network (GN) :- Accenture GNs Data AI (AI Hub India) practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways. Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data - insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling to outperform the competition.

 WHATS IN IT FOR YOU 

As part of our Analytics practice, you will join a worldwide network of over 20k+ smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading AI/ML/Statistical tools/Agentic AI systems, methods and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically-informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.

 What you would do in this role 

A Consultant/Manager/Analyst for Customer Data Platforms serves as the day-to-day marketing technology point of contact and helps our clients get value out of their investment into a Customer Data Platform (CDP) by developing a strategic roadmap focused on personalized activation. You will be working with a multidisciplinary team of Solution Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and Digital Marketers.

As part of that, we are seeking a highly skilled Consultant/Manager/Analyst to architect, build, and operationalize custom Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Agentic AI systems and marketing data solutions on the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will be at the intersection of data engineering, MLOps, and marketing technology, building the foundational infrastructure that enables our clients to understand their customers, predict their needs, and deliver personalized experiences at scale.



 Key Duties and Responsibilities:(GCP CDP) 
 Architect Design: Lead the technical design and architecture of enterprise-grade, custom CDPs and marketing data warehouses on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Build Production-Grade Data Pipelines: Engineer robust, scalable, and automated data pipelines for both streaming and batch ingestion using services like Cloud Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Functions. Containerize processing jobs with Docker for portability and scalability. Model for Insight Activation: Design and implement data models in BigQuery optimized for customer identity resolution, 360-degree profile creation, segmentation, and analytics. Champion DevOps MLOps: Champion and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. Build CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build to automate testing and deployment, manage container images in Artifact Registry, and secure credentials using Google Secret Manager. Deploy Serve: Develop and deploy containerized, serverless APIs (using Docker and Cloud Run) for real-time data ingestion and activation, feeding customer segments and triggers into marketing platforms. Operationalize Machine Learning: Collaborate with data scientists to productionize ML models (e.g., propensity, LTV, segmentation) using the Vertex AI platform. Build automated training pipelines, and deploy models for real-time inference. Collaborate Innovate: Work within a multi-disciplinary team to translate business requirements into technical solutions, prototype new approaches, and provide expert guidance on the art of the possible with GCP and modern data engineering. Ensure Governance Security: Implement solutions that adhere to data governance best practices and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), ensuring data is handled securely and ethically. 

 Key Duties and Responsibilities:(RTCDP) 
 Be a platform expert in Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Real time CDP). Developer level expertise on Adobe RTCDP (Adobe Experience Platform) is a must with other CDP platforms like Lytics, Segment, Amperity, Tealium, Treasure Data etc. including custom build CDPs as an added advantage Deep developer level expertise for real time event tracking for web analytics e.g., Google Tag Manager, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, etc. Provide deep domain expertise in our clients business and broad knowledge of digital marketing together with a Marketing Strategist industry Deep expert level knowledge of reporting tools like GA360/GA4, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics Deep expert level knowledge of paid media destinations - Google Ads, DV360, Campaign Manager, Facebook Ads Manager, The Trading desk etc. Deep developer expertise for Journey Orchestration and Personalization tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer Assess and audit the current state of a clients marketing technology stack (MarTech) including data infrastructure, ad platforms and data security policies together with a solutions architect. Conduct stakeholder interviews and gather business requirements Translate business requirements into BRDs, CDP customer analytics use cases, structure technical solution Prioritize CDP use cases together with the client. Create a strategic CDP roadmap focused on data driven marketing activation. Work with the Solution Architect to strategize, architect, and document a scalable CDP/Martech implementation, tailored to the clients needs. Able to integrate multiple Martech tools. Ensure analytics are consistently implemented across digital properties. Diagnose and troubleshoot analytics/Martech implementation and platform configuration issues. Perform end-to-end QA testing for integrations. Coordinate with website developers for Analytics integration, datalayer implementation, Martech tools integration Design and Implement Adobe Stack Martech tools like Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Launch, Adobe Web SDK, Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics Deep domain expertise in Tag Management, Journey Orchestration, Campaign Management, A/B Testing Perform technical analysis design for Martech related initiatives. Define requirements for Martech implementation/reporting dashboard. 

 Key Duties and Responsibilities:(Agentic AI) 
 Architect the core interaction logic and decision-making frameworks for enterprise-grade, agentic AI systems within marketing on GCP. Leverage Google Agent Development Kit (ADKs) and APIs to orchestrate complex, multi-step agentic workflows, focusing on reasoning capabilities. Design agentic AI systems for scalability, robustness, and real-time responsiveness in autonomous marketing decision-making. Design and implement data storage strategies (Datastores) optimized for efficient retrieval of context for AI agents. Design, implement, and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to equip Gemini agents with contextually relevant information from various knowledge sources. Leverage Gemini models'' reasoning capabilities to enable agents for complex analysis, strategic planning, and problem-solving in marketing contexts. Develop and apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) to guide and enhance the reasoning, accuracy, and output quality of AI agents. Implement and leverage grounding evaluation capabilities within Agentic AI systems to ensure outputs are factually accurate, contextually relevant, and traceable to specific data sources for marketing applications. Develop and deploy AI-driven solutions for generating multimodal marketing assets (e.g., personalized images, video snippets, audio messages) powered by Gemini. Implement LLMops best practices for the lifecycle management of agentic AI models, including CI/CD for AI components. Ensure secure and compliant interactions for AI agents, managing credentials and secrets relevant to AI model access. Implement robust monitoring, logging, and observability specifically for the performance, decision paths, and output quality of agentic AI systems. Prototype new approaches and provide expert guidance on GCP AI services, Gemini, RAG, advanced prompting, and reasoning AI techniques. Create insights presentations and client-ready decks, effectively communicating findings and recommendations. Mentor and guide junior resources, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team environment. Demonstrate strong communication skills, both verbal and written, to effectively convey complex concepts and insights to stakeholders. Develop strong relationships with clients at all levels, understanding their specific challenges and opportunities. 

 Other roles and responsibilities 
 Business intelligence expertise for insights, actionable recommendations. Project management expertise for sprint planning Provide hands-on support and platform training for our clients. Data processing, data engineer and data schema/models expertise for CDPs to work on data models, unification logic etc. Work with Business Analysts, Data Architects, Technical Architects, DBAs to achieve project objectives - delivery dates, quality objectives etc. 

  Qualification  

 Who are we looking for 
 B Tech/M Tech from reputed engineering colleges Masters/M Tech in Computer Science Master degree in Statistics/Econometrics/ Economics from reputed institute M.Phil/Ph.D in Statistics/Econometrics or related field 3+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering or software engineering with a data focus. At least 2+ years of demonstrable experience building and managing data solutions on a major cloud platform (GCP is strongly preferred; AWS/Azure experience is valuable) At least 2+ years of relevant work experience in marketing, consulting, or analytics Strong understanding of data governance and compliance (i.e. PII, PHI, GDPR, CCPA) Experience with analytics tools like Google Analytics or Adobe Analytics or Adobe Customer Journey Analytics is a plus. Developer experience with tag management platforms like Adobe Launch/AEP Web SDK, Google Tag Manager, Tealium iQ. Certification in any one is plus Strong understanding of implementation of consent management platforms e.g. Sourcepoint, OneTrust on digital assets Experience in requirement gathering, solution design, tag implementation and audits, Martech tools integration Experience in defining measurement frameworks for websites/app, suggesting KPIs to track, driving strategy for customer engagement Strong experience in ETL, data aggregation and transformation using SQL is a must Experience in mobile analytics implementations is a nice to have Good to have programming experience in PySpark, Python, Shell Scripts. RDBMS, TSQL, NoSQL experience is a plus Manage large volumes of structured and unstructured data, extract clean data to make it amenable for analysis. Experience in deployment and operationalizing the code is an added advantage. Experience with source control systems such as Git, Bitbucket, and Jenkins build and continuous integration tools. Proficient in Excel, MS word, PowerPoint, etc

 At least 2+ years of relevant work experience of implementing CDP solutions with deep understanding of identity resolution methods with minimum 1 year in Adobe RTCDP At least 2+ years of relevant work experience in marketing, consulting, or analytics At least 2+ years of experience working in an agency environment At least 2 years of experience working as Subject matter expert in Adobe Marketing Cloud Stack Experience with A/B testing tools like Adobe Target is a plus. Experience with Campaign Management tools like Adobe Journey Optimizer or/and Adobe Campaign is a plus. Experience with Adobe Marketing Cloud tools like Adobe Workfront, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), DAM is a plus Experience in Postman APIs is a plus Strong hands-on with advanced JavaScript and jQuery. Able to develop custom tags/scripts using tag managers

At least 2 years of demonstrable experience building and managing data/AI solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Demonstrable experience building and deploying agentic AI systems, leveraging LLMs for complex decision-making. Hands-on experience with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and integrating external knowledge sources for LLMs. Proven ability to apply advanced prompting techniques (e.g., Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot) to guide and enhance LLM reasoning and output quality. Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer (PMLE) certification is highly desired. Exceptional problem-solving and analytical capabilities, particularly in understanding and applying reasoning to complex problems. Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive, innovative, and results-driven approach. A collaborative spirit and the capacity to mentor and guide junior team members.

title: Engineer 3
description:
About the Role We are looking for a curious and team-focused Full Stack Software Engineer to join the our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will build and maintain the backend services, and user-facing analytics experiences that power operational insights for Anaplan. You will be responsible for presenting customers and internal users with the data they need to drive their decision making. You will have a lead role in this system and will be responsible for mentoring junior developers and ensuring standards are met. You will work as a full stack developer, responsible for building the REST APIs and web UIs needed to make this data available in a performance and reliable way. We build services in Python and React. This role suits an engineer who is accountable, collaborative, and comfortable moving between data, backend, and frontend work. There will be opportunities to engage with and learn from other parts of the ODL platform including a modern Lakehouse built on Databricks. 
 Key Responsibilities Architect and develop high-performance REST services in Python, guide integration with existing product backends where needed. Lead design and delivery of frontend features for analytics / diagnostics UIs (React / TypeScript). Own strategy and execution of CI/CD for resilient automated deployments across services and the UI. Champion test development across API, and UI layers; mentor engineers on effective testing. Partner with product, analytics, and platform stakeholders to translate business needs into end-to-end technical solutions Drive technical approach for UI delivery (APIs, and usable dashboards/experiences). Lead investigation of correctness, performance, and scalability issues across the stack. Mentor engineers; foster a team-focused, data-driven culture. Take accountability for health and scalability of systems in scope. 
 Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with a proven track record of technical leadership and full-stack delivery Expert-level programming skills in Python. Deep experience designing and building scalable REST services (Python preferred ). Strong experience with modern frontend development (React and TypeScript preferred). Proven success with automated CI/CD pipelines. Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure automation. Advanced SQL / notebook / Pandas experience for data validation and debugging. Experience mentoring engineers and leading complex cross-cutting technical projects. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 Preferred Qualifications Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and cloud-native design. Strong understanding of Kubernetes and Docker in production. Experience implementing modern observability stacks (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Experience building productized BI experiences from the ground up Exposure to Spark / Databricks or similar distributed data processing frameworks or data science tools Experience with Spring Boot

Key Skills: Terraform,Rest API Services,React.js,Python,SQL,TypeScript,Rest,API
